Español
En el Día Mundial de la EPOC, comparto esta conversación con LA NACION sobre una enfermedad que todavía permanece demasiado invisible: más del 70% de las personas con EPOC no han recibido un diagnóstico.

La detección temprana puede cambiar vidas. Respirar es un derecho, no un privilegio.
Gracias a gabriela navarra Camerucci y a LA NACIÓN por contribuir a que la salud pulmonar ocupe el lugar que merece en la conversación pública.

Lee la entrevista:
https://lnkd.in/dwVhcubN
#DíaMundialDeLaEPOC #EPOC #SaludPulmonar #RespirarEsUnDerecho

English
On World COPD Day, I’m sharing this conversation with LA NACIÓN about a disease that remains far too invisible: more than 70% of people with COPD have not been diagnosed.
Early diagnosis can change lives. Breathing is a right, not a privilege.

Thank you to Gabriela Navarra Camerucci and LA NACIÓN for helping bring lung health into the public conversation.

#WorldCOPDDay #COPD #LungHealth #BreathingIsARight
World Health Organization Pace Center for Global Health

text:
A new study in @BMJOpen_Resp suggests that early-life exposure to #airpollution is linked to poorer lung function 🫁 in childhood, and that the difference persists into adolescence.

Researchers from the University of Copenhagen followed 846 mother-child pairs in the Danish COPSAC2000 and COPSAC2010 cohorts. They modelled exposure to PM2.5 and NO₂ during #pregnancy and the first year of life, and measured lung function from age 3 to 18. Each extra 2 µg/m³ of PM2.5 during pregnancy was associated with nearly 2% lower #lung capacity at age six, and higher exposure was linked to slower lung development through childhood and adolescence.

These effects showed up at relatively low levels. The average annual PM2.5 in the study was 9.6 µg/m³, compared with the @WHO guideline of 5 µg/m³. A

For one child the difference is small, but across a population even small shifts matter for #health. Protecting pregnant women and young children from polluted air is an early investment in lifelong lung health.
